name: cic-baseline-healthcheck
description: Authoritative CIC system health probe validating ingestion → harvester → PMS → model → orchestrator → synthesizer → audit.

checks.name: E2E Pipeline Test
checks.description: Runs the full CIC pipeline against the local Control Plane API using the golden-path test suite.

checks.name: PMS Integration Test
checks.description: Validates PMS pack loading, dependency resolution, section merging, and schema assertions.

checks.name: Harvester Golden-Path Test
checks.description: Mocks Gemini and validates the Ingest → Harvester → PMS → Model execution chain.

notes: This manifest defines the authoritative health baseline for CIC v2.13.0.
The pipeline-e2e check is the primary system heartbeat.
All checks must pass before promoting a new CIC release to stable.
